desc: Implement prefix distinct counts `pref[i]` for i=1..N (distinct count in A[1..i]).
Implement suffix distinct counts `suf[i]` for i=1..N (distinct count in A[i..N]).
Compute `nxt[i]` = next index > i where A[nxt[i]] == A[i], or N+1 if none.
Build a segment tree over indices 1..N-1 supporting range add and range max (lazy propagation).
Initialize the tree with `suf[R+1]` for each R (R from 1 to N-1).
Iterate `s` from N-1 down to 2: set `total[s] = 1 + suf[s+1]`, add 1 to range `[s+1, nxt[s]-1]`, query max over `[s, N-1]`, update answer with `pref[s-1] + max`.
